name: shophub
description: Single-shop e-commerce platform: customer storefront, admin dashboard and REST API

scripts.setup: npm run setup:env -w backend && npm run setup:db -w backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run db:start -w backend" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w frontend && npm run test:e2e -w frontend
scripts.test:responsive: npm run build -w frontend && npm run test:responsive -w frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
